            Purpose:          This bulletin rescinds 1 Memorandum (Memo) and 2 letters that are no longer applicable
                              under any code. Additionally, this bulletin conditionally rescinds 1 Memorandum (Memo) and
                              2 letters that are not applicable to projects filed under the 2014 New York City Construction
                              Codes.

          Subject(s):         Local Law 58/87; Memo, rescinded; Letter, rescinded; Appeal procedure, Local Law 58/87;
                              Minimum door size, Local Law 58/87; Vertical/inclined wheelchair lifts, Local Law 58/87;
                              Vertical/inclined wheelchair lifts, MEA; Elevator openings, Local Law 58/87; Stair, Local Law
                              58/87; RS 4-6, Strobe warning devices


The Department of Buildings is currently in the process of reviewing published Buildings Bulletins (BBs), Policy and
Procedure Notices (Technical, Operational, Legal, Administrative, OTCR), and various memoranda, directives, and
letters to see if changes are necessary to reflect current Department practice and incorporate new laws and
regulations.

Effective immediately, the following documents are to be rescinded:
     Memo dated 12-10-87 – Re: Local Law 58/87 Appeal Procedure
     Letter dated 5-15-90 – Re: Local Law 58/87 Minimum Door Size
     Letter dated 10-31-90 – Re: Local Law 58/87 Vertical/Inclined Wheelchair Lifts

The following documents are applicable only to projects filed prior to the effective date of the 2014 New York City
Construction Codes and are identified as “2014 Code Rescinded”:
    Memo dated 10-6-88 – Re: Required Elevator Openings as per ANSI A117.1-1986 (Local Law 58 of 1987)
    Letter dated 6-29-90 – Re: Section 27-357(e), Building Code Reference Standard 4-6, Section 4.9
    Letter dated 5-6-91 – Re: Strobe Warning Devices in Sub-Systems

Rescinded documents will not be applicable to any projects after the issuance date of this Bulletin. They will appear
on the Department website with the watermark “RESCINDED.”
